description: An attic bedroom with a leaking skylight. Water drips steadily from the wet, stained ceiling onto the old wooden floor, where a bucket and pans catch it. A young woman in a burgundy jumper with damp hair hugs a black guitar case tightly to her chest with her eyes closed. A young man in a white T-shirt and grey joggers crouches beside her, smiles and holds out a checked cloth, then moves the pans and slips out of view as the view moves closer to her. A chest of drawers with an oil lamp is behind.
